title: Add DMJ Community License and Code of Conduct
approach: Create a new LICENSE file containing the custom DMJ Community License (DCL) text and a CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md describing community expectations. Update README.md to reference both files. Optionally adjust CI to only verify file existence. No code changes required.
tests_to_write: Test that a file named LICENSE exists at the repository root and contains the phrase "DMJ Community License".
Test that CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md exists and includes a "## Expected Behavior" heading.
Test that README.md contains a "License" section linking to the LICENSE file.
Test that README.md contains a "Code of Conduct" section linking to CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md.
edge_cases: CI workflow that checks for a specific SPDX identifier may fail because DCL is custom; ensure the CI step only checks for file existence or add a generic SPDX tag comment.
If future packaging (pyproject.toml/setup.cfg) is added, the license field must be set to "DCL" to avoid metadata mismatch.
